[[61 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' states that Gerams was around sixty [[Standard year|years]] old at the [[time]] of the [[Battle of Scarif]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, Gerams' must have been [[Reproduction|born]] around [[61 BBY]]. |death= |species=[[Human]]{{SWCT|set=Topps' Women of Star Wars|cardname=Jaldine Gerams (Blue Three)}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns=She/her''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Blonde]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] **[[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|We're having no effect on that shield.''"
"''How much more can that thing take?|Red Twelve and Jaldine Gerams|audio=Red12-Gerams-RO.flac|}} '''Jaldine Gerams''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Homeworld|from]] the [[planet]] [[Fresia]] who [[author]]ed advanced [[flight simulator]]s and tirelessly practiced in them with the [[dream]] of flying a real [[starfighter]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] arrived on Fresia, she jumped at the chance to join and fly an [[X-wing starfighter]]. A thoroughly professional [[Rebel pilot|pilot]], she flew as [[Blue Three]] in [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], a mixed unit based out of the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. In [[1 BBY]], Blue Squadron was scrambled with the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] to aid [[Rogue One|rebels]] who were trying to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] on the planet [[Scarif]]. Gerams eagerly followed [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]] into [[Space warfare|battle]] but did not manage to pass through the Imperial [[Shield Gate]] above Scarif with him, instead engaging [[Scarif fleet|Imperial forces]] above the planet. During the battle, Gerams sounded the alarm when an additional wave of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] launched from the Shield Gate. She later fired [[proton torpedo]]es into the gate in an unsuccessful effort to destroy it. The Alliance managed to eventually destroy the gate and steal the plans, although not without heavy losses. ==Biography== ===From simulators to Scarif=== {{Quote|Attention, all flight personnel, please report to your commanders immediately. All flight personnel, please report to your commanders immediately. We have been redirected to Scarif. Pilots, you'll be briefed by your squadron leaders en route. May the Force be with you.|An announcement by rebel [[Wedge Antilles]] in the Great Temple scrambles Blue Squadron and other rebel pilots|audio=ScarifAnnouncement-RO.flac|}} [[File:GeramsCockpit-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Jaldine Gerams flew for the Rebel Alliance as Blue Three.]] Jaldine Gerams was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Fresia]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[61 BBY]]. A [[programmer]] and [[computer]] specialist, she [[author]]ed several advanced{{SWCT|set=Topps' Women of Star Wars|cardname=Jaldine Gerams (Blue Three)}} [[starfighter]] [[Flight simulator|simulator]] programs and tirelessly immersed herself in them, logging many [[Standard hour|hours]] before she ever saw any real [[Starfighter combat|combat]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] arrived on Fresia, Gerams jumped at the opportunity to put her intense practice to use and fly a real [[X-wing starfighter]], joining up with the Alliance on the [[Standard day|day]] that she first encountered them. Flying under the [[callsign]] [[Blue Three]], Gerams joined [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], a mixed rebel [[Starship|starfighter]] [[squadron]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]] within the [[Massassi Group]] of rebels based in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. Shortly after the squadron was partially scrambled for a [[Mission to Eadu|mission]] to attack an [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory|Imperial laboratory]] on the planet [[Eadu]]''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' in [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]]. the whole squadron was scrambled for the first [[time]] in order to travel with the rest of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] to the [[Scarif system]], where a [[Rogue One|group]] of rebels was attempting to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. ===A squadron separated=== {{Quote|More fighters. Form up at six-five.|Jaldine Gerams spots incoming TIE fighters|audio=Fighters-Gerams-RO.flac|}} [[File:GeramsTIEs-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|Gerams sounded the alarm when more TIEs emerged from the Shield Gate.]] After exiting [[hyperspace]] in the Scarif [[Star system|system]], Blue Squadron was immediately ordered by [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]], [[commander]] of the Alliance [[fleet]], to head for the planet's surface to provide support to the rebels there. This required haste, as the Imperials had a [[planetary shield]] around Scarif that could only be passed through via a [[Shield Gate]] that they were rapidly closing. Merrick led the squadron in a dive through the gate; however, it finished closing before the entire unit made it through. Within the first moments of the battle, Gerams skills were put to the test when she managed to pull away from the gate without crashing, avoiding the fate of her squad mate [[Vangos Grek]] and two other [[Rebel pilot|pilots]]. Separated from Merrick and those who had made it through, Gerams and fellow Blue Squadron members, including [[Barion Raner]] and [[Heff Tobber]], instead joined the other rebel starfighter squadrons in [[Space warfare|fighting]] the [[Scarif fleet|Imperial fleet]] above Scarif. When many additional [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] launched from the [[hangar]]s of the Shield Gate, it was Gerams who sounded the alarm and ordered two X-wings flying with her to form up at the coordinates six-five. The trio then flew away from the gate past the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of Raddus's [[flagship]], ''[[Profundity]]'', with the [[TIE series|TIEs]] giving chase. ===Shield Gate strike=== [[File:GeramsShieldAttack-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Gerams' attacks on the Shield Gate had little effect.]] Later in the battle, Gerams flew alongside rebel [[pilot]] [[Red Twelve (Rebel Alliance)|Red Twelve]] and another X-wing pilot in an attack run on the Shield Gate. After firing [[proton torpedo]]es directly at the sealed gate to no effect, the trio of fighters pulled up and away from the gate as Red Twelve reported their lack of effect, causing Gerams to wonder how much damage the Shield Gate could sustain. Eventually, the rebels managed to destroy the gate by causing the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Persecutor]]''''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' to collide with it, allowing the rebels on the surface to successfully transmit the plans to the fleet. The rebels on the ground and all members of Blue Squadron who had passed through the gate then [[Death|perished]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Weapons & Uniforms}} when the [[Death Star]] itself then arrived and fired on Scarif, although some members of the squadron did manage to then escape with the remainder of the rebel fleet. Between Eadu and Scarif, Blue and [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] lost a combined total of nineteen pilots. So few members of Blue Squadron were left that the Alliance was unsure they would even be able to field it when the Death Star then [[Battle of Yavin|attacked]] the rebel base at Yavin.{{StoryCite|story=Duty Roster|book=From a Certain Point of View}} Ultimately, only Red Squadron, [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]], and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] participated.''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' ==Personality and traits== Jaldine Gerams always [[dream]]ed of flying a starfighter and grabbed the opportunity when first encountering the rebellion. Her quiet and tireless training on simulators honed her real-life aerial skills and qualified her as a pilot. A thoroughly professional flier, she eagerly followed Merrick to Scarif when given the opportunity. Gerams had [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]], light skin, and blue [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== [[File:JaldineGeramsHelmet-ROUVG.png|thumb|left|200px|Jaldine Gerams' flight helmet]] While flying an X-wing at Scarif, Gerams wore a blue [[flight suit]] with a white [[flak vest]], gray [[glove]]s, and a gray [[Diagnostech life support unit]]. Her [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] was primarily gray with white portions around the visor and sides and a gray and black grid above the visor, with light blue lines along the top ridge and on the grid. On each side of the [[helmet]] there was a black symbol with several lines passing through a circle, an emblem that was also found on the helmets of a number of other rebel pilots including her squad mates Raner and [[Torius Chord]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|They rang up and said 'Would you like to do two days on Star Wars, playing an X-Wing pilot?' and I said there was nothing I'd like to do more in my life but sadly I couldn't because I had to organise my daughter's wedding.|Geraldine James|{{WebCite|url=https://www.denofgeek.com/tv/geraldine-james-interview-anne-with-an-e-star-wars-shakespeare|text=Geraldine James interview: Anne With An E, Star Wars, Shakespeare|author=Louisa Mellor|date=2018-07-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Den of Geek|Den of Geek]]|archivedate=20230930064134}}}} [[File:GeraldineJames.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jaldine Gerams was portrayed by Geraldine James.]] Jaldine Gerams was portrayed by [[Geraldine James]] in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. Despite wanting to, James almost did not take the role, as the two days of filming on a [[Wikipedia:Gimbal|gimbal]]{{YouTube|video=WnMW9LGG1oI|text=Geraldine James on Anne With An E, her career, and Star Wars|channel=@LondonLive|name=London Live|date=2018-07-10}} was scheduled to take place two weeks before her daughter's wedding; however, her daughter and husband demanded she not miss the opportunity and James greatly enjoyed playing the pilot. Credited only as Blue Three, the character was first identified with a [[tuckerization]] of James's name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film. James found the naming hilarious. The guide erroneously states that Gerams managed to fly through the Shield Gate to Scarif. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Jaldine Gerams|imagecat=Images of Jaldine Gerams}} *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] {{Voice}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Jaldine Gerams}} *{{SWCT|set=Star Wars: Rogue One - Standing By|cardname=Jaldine Gerams (Blue 3)}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Weapons & Uniforms}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars High Tek|cardname=Jaldine Gerams|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/176308/cid/11322216/2017-Topps-High-Tek-Star-Wars---Gold-Rainbow-Foil-111-Jaldine-Gerams}} *{{SWCT|set=Topps' Women of Star Wars|cardname=Jaldine Gerams (Blue Three)}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Birth of the Rebellion}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Pilots of the Rebel Alliance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{WebCite|url=https://www.jonathanolley.co.uk/film-television-unit-photography/rogue-one|text=Rogue One|author=[[Jonathan Olley]]|archivedate=20240319104553}} {{Interlang |cs=Jaldine Gerams |de=Jaldine Gerams#kanon |es=Jaldine Gerams |fr=Jaldine Gerams |ja=ジャルディーン・ジェラムス |nl=Jaldine Gerams |pl=Jaldine Gerams |uk=Джалдін Ґерамс }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Gerams, Jaldine}} [[Category:Blue Squadron personnel]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Programmers]]
